title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 6: Satomi Yoshida
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．６ ～吉田里深～
overview:
A big breakout on the way!? Here comes Satomi, the gravure queen everyone is watching right now!!

Volume 6 of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection and quiz disc starring model Satomi Yoshida, with photography by Kazuo Ito. Browse her photo album, learn more about her through an interview of 100 questions, and play mini games including a "look this way" game and a quiz.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- 100 Questions: Q&A interview
- Game Hall: "look this way" and a quiz
- Production credits

大ブレイクの予感!? 今が旬の注目グラビアクィーン里深チャン登場!!
